sph_interpretive_translation: One who obstructs sacred offerings, violates the rights of a brother's wife, fails to fulfill directed obligations, or breaches the sanctity of a royal household—such beings disrupt cosmic order through misaligned consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with cosmic dharma, not positional power.
Causation arises from conscious intent disrupting relational harmony.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness of relational duty.
Restoration logic prioritizes reintegration over punitive isolation.
Consciousness alignment restores natural justice without external enforcement.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent obstructs sacred offering THEN initiate completion protocol for energetic restoration.
IF agent violates familial boundary THEN assign capacity-realignment process under guru supervision.
IF agent fails directed obligation THEN activate karmic tracing until fulfillment is completed.
IF agent breaches royal sanctum THEN enforce consciousness purification through ritual discipline.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, threshold of responsibility lies in demonstrable disruption of dharmic field; authority flows from alignment with Sanatana Dharma, not institutional position; restoration precedes procedural formality.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals causal sequence from disrupted consciousness to manifested harm; anupūrvaśaḥ traces energetic disturbance back to source; proportional response aligns perpetrator’s capacity with corrective integration; no punitive outcome occurs outside individual consciousness correction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Agnihotra Completion Process to restore obstructed offering energy.
Assign Bhrātṛ-Bhāryā Boundary Reconciliation under Vedic counselor guidance.
Activate Sandiṣṭa Pratipatti Protocol to ensure directed duty fulfillment.
Enforce Samudra-Gṛha Śuddhi Ritual to purify breached royal domain.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law executes Dharma as non-punitive restoration, consciousness as supreme judge, and reality as eternally aligned when error is dissolved.
